transcript:

My name is Neha, a home baker in Jaipur. One day, a foreign customer came, but due to my poor English, I kept stuttering and she cancelled the order, costing me a loss of 15,000. That night, I downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. With a ₹1 trial, I practiced 15 minutes daily with an AI coach without hesitation. Three months later, I confidently secured another order by speaking fluent English.]
Speaker B: इंस्टॉल नाउ पर क्लिक करो और अभी इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]

तीन हफ़्तों में सिर्फ 15 मिनट इंग्लिश प्रैक्टिस... [Just 15 minutes of English practice in three weeks...]

summary: An animated home baker named Neha shares how she lost a high-value order from a foreign customer due to her inability to speak English. She then downloads the 'English Seekho' app, practices daily with an AI coach for a ₹1 trial, and successfully secures future clients with her improved English skills.
